rules.rule: Check for adverse reaction after vaccination
rules.problem: check_for omits the SpO2 measurement (Oxygen sats < 92%) that the anaphylaxis rule uses; the 15/30-minute observation period is not represented. Otherwise the list matches the page's symptom boxes.

The faint/unwell group is counted as one of the 2+ body systems without the page's gate that faint symptoms must fail to improve quickly after positioning; vasovagal dizziness/sweating + nausea will fire probable anaphylaxis. The single-system serious branch, generalised urticaria branch and any2 structure otherwise match the flowchart. Page wording is 'Treat as anaphylaxis', not 'likely'. 'If in doubt, treat as anaphylaxis' is not encoded (acceptable).

rules.rule: Diagnose probable pseudoallergic rash after vaccination
rules.problem: Matches the page's 'pseudoallergic self-limiting rash likely' with correct 'probable' and a faithful concept, but drops the 'monitor for at least 30 minutes' window and negates itching, which usually accompanies hives.

summary: Most consequential: the anaphylaxis rule counts faint/unwell (vasovagal) symptoms as a body system unconditionally, although the page only sends them to the anaphylaxis decision when they do not improve quickly after positioning, so common vasovagal + nausea presentations become probable anaphylaxis. The pseudoallergic rule drops the 30-minute monitoring window and negates itching; minor concept issues are 'Blurring of visual image' for darkening/white-out of vision and pre-coordinated swelling concepts (Lip/Tongue/Facial swelling) that exist.
